abi.name: pz_mib
notes: All multi-byte fields are little-endian, fixed width, naturally aligned; no native pointers, no compiler padding.
Records are 8-byte aligned; length includes the 16-byte header; crc32 (IEEE, reflected 0xEDB88320) covers the whole record with the crc field zeroed.
Legacy diagnostic images identify as 0x70350001 / 0x70351001 and are rejected before arm.

Processing results are carried as an opaque payload inside RESULT records. Their layout is defined per (science_profile, profile_version) by the processing track (pz7035-imx426#7), not by this platform ABI.

Frame store (capability FRAME_STORE): every accepted frame is written to a round-robin ring in PS DDR as a store record = the frame's wire record set (FRAME, RESULT*, EVENT*, IMAGE*) followed by the image blocks the IMAGE records point at. The same bytes are drained to local storage (capability STORE_DRAIN). Store records are self-describing and 512-byte aligned.

ABI 1.2 (2026-09-30, docs/decisions/0002): additive profile parameter page (PROFILE_PAGE_SHADOW/APPLIED, committed with the config epoch), table loader for PS-computed backgrounds and profile tables, LIMIT_FRAME_PERIOD_TICKS, RESULT flags VALID and UNSERVED. Profile-specific meaning of the page and payload is defined per profile under abi/profiles/.

rules: identity must equal identity_magic and board_id must match, else reject before arm
abi major must be equal; abi minor on the device must be >= the minor the host was generated from
every capability the selected operating mode requires must be set in CAPABILITIES, else reject before arm
record version must be <= the generated version for that record type; unknown trailing bytes within length are ignored (additive fields)
a record whose length is below the generated minimum for its type is invalid

a RESULT payload is interpreted only if the host has a decoder for its (science_profile, profile_version); otherwise the envelope is still delivered and the payload is reported unavailable, never zero
the host must reject arm if SCIENCE_PROFILE names a profile the selected operating mode does not expect

map.name: IDENTITY
map.doc: 0x505A4D42 'PZMB'; legacy images return 0x7035xxxx and are rejected

map.name: ABI_VERSION
map.doc: major[31:16] minor[15:0]

map.name: BUILD_ID0
map.doc: BUILD_ID3..0: the first 128 bits of the PL build's git commit, most significant word in BUILD_ID3 (the 32-hex prefix reads ID3 ID2 ID1 ID0 as %08x each); this word holds hex digits 25-32

map.name: CAPABILITIES
map.doc: bitmask capabilities (platform features only; science is identified by SCIENCE_PROFILE)

map.name: SCIENCE_PROFILE
map.doc: enum science_profile (registry; the profile's internals belong to the processing track) [15:0], profile_version [31:16]

map.name: PROFILE_ID0
map.doc: PROFILE_ID3..0: the first 128 bits of the sha256 of the profile's assets (the model weights .npz), most significant word in PROFILE_ID3 (the 32-hex prefix reads ID3 ID2 ID1 ID0 as %08x each); zero when none; this word holds hex digits 25-32

map.name: STATE
map.doc: enum state

map.name: FAULT
map.doc: sticky bitmask fault; cleared only by CONTROL.FAULT_CLEAR

map.name: GENERATION
map.doc: reset generation; descriptors and completions carry it

map.name: CONTROL
map.doc: bitmask control; self-clearing pulses. INHIBIT asserts the output inhibit; RELEASE_INHIBIT clears it only while ARMED/RUNNING without fault. ARM, STOP, fault and reset leave or put outputs inhibited.

map.name: RUN_ID_LO
map.doc: 64-bit run id written by the host before ARM; copied into every record

map.name: EPOCH
map.doc: currently applied configuration epoch

map.name: CONFIG_COMMIT
map.doc: write the new epoch value to request an atomic apply of the shadow block at the next frame boundary

map.name: COMMIT_STATUS
map.doc: enum commit_status

map.name: FIRST_EFFECTIVE_FRAME_LO
map.doc: frame id of the first frame processed with the acked epoch

map.name: IRQ_STATUS
map.doc: bitmask irq

map.name: GEOMETRY
map.doc: width[15:0] height[31:16] of the applied configuration

map.name: PIXEL_FORMAT
map.doc: enum pixel_format[7:0], stride_bytes[31:8]

map.name: TIMESTAMP_HZ
map.doc: tick rate of all timestamps; 64-bit free-running, reset only by RESET_GENERATION, never wraps in practice (2^64 ticks)

map.name: TIMESTAMP_LO
map.doc: latched by SNAPSHOT together with the counters

map.name: SNAPSHOT
map.doc: write 1: latch TIMESTAMP and all COUNTER words coherently from the counter clock domain

map.name: SNAPSHOT_SEQ
map.doc: increments when a snapshot completes; read before and after the counters to detect a torn read

map.name: LIMIT_RESULTS
map.doc: results per frame the image can emit

map.name: LIMIT_RESULT_BYTES
map.doc: result bytes per frame the image can emit

map.name: LIMIT_INFLIGHT
map.doc: frames the device may own at once

map.name: LIMIT_RESULT_PAYLOAD_WORDS
map.doc: payload words per RESULT record

map.name: LIMIT_FRAME_PERIOD_TICKS
map.doc: minimum frame period (TIMESTAMP_HZ ticks) the applied profile sustains; 0 = no profile limit. The PS combines it with the sensor geometry and store admission to report the achievable frame rate

map.name: COUNTER
map.doc: snapshot copies, index order in counters[]

map.name: CONFIG_SHADOW
map.doc: inactive candidate; readback returns what was written

map.name: CONFIG_APPLIED
map.doc: configuration in effect since EPOCH

map.name: RESULT_RING_BASE_LO
map.doc: kernel-provided bus address of the result descriptor ring; host never passes arbitrary userspace addresses

map.name: RESULT_RING_ENTRIES
map.doc: power of two

map.name: RESULT_RING_HEAD
map.doc: device write index

map.name: RESULT_RING_TAIL
map.doc: cpu release index

map.name: PREVIEW_RING_BASE_LO
map.doc: bus address of preview slot 0; slot n is at base + n * PREVIEW_SLOT_BYTES

map.name: PREVIEW_RING_ENTRIES
map.doc: number of preview slots (<= 8)

map.name: PREVIEW_RING_HEAD
map.doc: newest READY slot + 1; 0 when none

map.name: PREVIEW_RING_TAIL
map.doc: reserved (previews are latest-value slots, not a ring)

map.name: PREVIEW_SLOT_BYTES
map.doc: bytes per preview slot; multiple of 128

map.name: PREVIEW_HOLD
map.doc: write: bitmask of slots the CPU wants to hold; the device grants a bit only for a slot that is READY and not being written. read: granted mask. A held slot is never written; clearing its bit frees it.

map.name: PREVIEW_READY
map.doc: bitmask of READY slots

map.name: PREVIEW_SLOT_FRAME
map.doc: frame id of each slot's content, slot n at words 2n (low) and 2n+1 (high); authoritative after a hold is granted

map.name: STORE_BASE_LO
map.doc: bus address of the frame store ring (PS DDR); kernel-provided

map.name: STORE_RECORDS
map.doc: number of store records in the ring = floor(region bytes / STORE_RECORD_BYTES); written by the host before ARM (<= 65535)

map.name: STORE_RECORD_BYTES
map.doc: bytes per store record for the applied configuration; multiple of 512

map.name: STORE_MODE
map.doc: enum store_mode[7:0]; bit 8 include INT8_CODES image; applied at ARM

map.name: STORE_PRE_FRAMES
map.doc: TRIGGER mode: frames kept before the trigger

map.name: STORE_POST_FRAMES
map.doc: TRIGGER mode: frames kept after the trigger

map.name: STORE_TRIGGER
map.doc: write 1: trigger (TRIGGER mode, once per run)

map.name: STORE_STATE
map.doc: enum store_state[7:0]; bit 8 window done (sticky until ARM)

map.name: STORE_HEAD_SEQ
map.doc: store sequence of the newest record (frame index within the run)

map.name: STORE_DRAIN_SEQ
map.doc: first store sequence not yet drained

map.name: STORE_LOST
map.doc: records overwritten before they were drained (round-robin)

map.name: STORE_DRAINED
map.doc: records written to local storage this run

map.name: STORE_DRAIN_ERRORS
map.doc: failed storage commands (retried); STORE_DRAIN fault after 4 in a row

map.name: STORE_TRIGGER_SEQ
map.doc: store sequence at the trigger

map.name: STORE_DRAIN_LBA_LO
map.doc: next 512-byte sector on the local drive; written by the host before ARM, advanced by the device

map.name: STORE_DRAIN_ENABLE
map.doc: bit 0 drain to local storage; bit 1 storage link enable

map.name: STORE_SET_BYTES
map.doc: bytes reserved at the start of every store record for its record set (FRAME, IMAGE*, RESULT*, EVENT*); a power of two fixed by the image. A set that does not fit keeps only the FRAME record with RESULTS_OVERFLOW; the image blocks stay at their fixed offsets: MONO8 at STORE_SET_BYTES, then MASK1, then INT8_CODES

map.name: PROFILE_PAGE_SHADOW
map.doc: capability PROFILE_PAGE: profile parameter page candidate, meaning defined by the active science profile (abi/profiles/); committed atomically with CONFIG_SHADOW by CONFIG_COMMIT

map.name: PROFILE_PAGE_APPLIED
map.doc: profile page in effect since EPOCH

map.name: TABLE_SELECT
map.doc: capability TABLE_LOADER: enum table_id [7:0]; writing it resets TABLE_ADDR and the running crc. BACKGROUND writes the inactive bank, which becomes current at the next committed BACKGROUND_EPOCH (swap at SOF)

map.name: TABLE_ADDR
map.doc: byte address inside the selected table; advances by 4 on every TABLE_DATA write

map.name: TABLE_DATA
map.doc: little-endian table word at TABLE_ADDR

map.name: TABLE_STATUS
map.doc: [0] busy, [1] address out of range (sticky until TABLE_SELECT), [31:8] bytes written since TABLE_SELECT

map.name: TABLE_CRC32
map.doc: crc32 (IEEE, reflected) of the bytes written since TABLE_SELECT; the host compares it before committing

map.name: TABLE_BYTES
map.doc: capacity in bytes of the selected table; 0 = table absent in this image

map.name: SCRATCH
map.doc: host bus sanity check

fields.name: length
fields.doc: total bytes including header, multiple of 8, <= MAX_RECORD_BYTES

fields.name: sequence
fields.doc: per-run, per-ring monotonic; wraps at 2^32; a gap is reported, a repeat is rejected

fields.name: frame_id
fields.doc: physical sensor frame counter, monotonic within a generation

RESULT.doc: platform envelope for one processing result; the payload words are profile-defined

fields.name: payload_validity
fields.doc: profile-defined validity bits for payload fields

EVENT.doc: a decision and, if issued, the physical output it produced

fields.name: decision_timestamp
fields.doc: ticks when the decision was taken

fields.name: output_timestamp
fields.doc: ticks when the physical output asserted; 0 unless decision == ISSUED

PREVIEW.doc: describes one sampled preview image in the preview ring; replaceable, never required data

fields.name: generation
fields.doc: low 16 bits of GENERATION; mismatch is STALE_GENERATION

IMAGE.doc: describes one image block of a store record; the block follows the record set at byte_offset from the start of the store record and is never inline (MAX_RECORD_BYTES)

fields.name: byte_offset
fields.doc: from the first byte of the store record; multiple of 8

fields.name: pixel_format
fields.doc: enum pixel_format: MONO8 raw, MASK1 packed LSB-first, INT8_CODES

axi4_stream.tlast: end of line (EOL) on the pixel stream; the DMA packetizer converts to end-of-frame-packet TLAST and must assert it exactly once per frame after the last EOL
axi4_stream.backpressure: TREADY may deassert anywhere; the ingress FIFO absorbs at most one line, beyond which the frame is marked INVALID and FRAMES_LOST increments; the sensor link itself is never stalled

stream.interrupt_order: RESULT_READY is raised only after the descriptor state is READY and the record bytes are visible to the CPU (write barrier in the DMA engine); COMMIT_ACK is raised after FIRST_EFFECTIVE_FRAME is valid
stream.partial_frames: a frame with INVALID or PARTIAL flags never produces RESULT or EVENT records; its FRAME record is still emitted so accounting stays complete
stream.resynchronization: after RX_LINK fault the receiver resyncs on the next Start Code; FRAMES_LOST counts frames observed by XVS but not accepted
stream.preview: Preview frames are chosen at SOF: every PREVIEW_DECIMATION-th RUNNING frame. The slot is the lowest FREE slot, else the oldest READY slot (its unread preview counts as dropped). The slot becomes READY at frame end if the frame is valid and the write completed; otherwise it returns to FREE and the preview counts as dropped.
